chunks: When God created the Intellect, He made it speak. Then He said to it: 'Come forward!' and it came forward. Then He said to it: 'Turn back!' and it turned back.
Then He said: 'By My Might and My Majesty! I have not created any creature more beloved to Me than you, nor have I perfected you except in those whom I love.
Indeed, it is you whom I command, and you whom I forbid, and you whom I punish, and you whom I reward.'

key_terms.أَكْمَلْتُكَ: I perfected you — God's perfection of the Intellect is restricted to those He loves, linking 'Aql to divine election
key_terms.اسْتَنْطَقَهُ: istantaqahu — He made it speak/interrogated it; tested the Intellect's responsiveness to divine command
key_terms.الْعَقْل: 'Aql — Intellect/Reason; a cosmic principle in Shia theology, the first creation and the basis of human accountability
key_terms.وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي: An oath formula by God's Might and Majesty, affirming the absolute seriousness of what follows

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith about the creation of the Intellect ('Aql) in al-Kafi teach?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates a cosmological hadith about the primordial creation of the Intellect ('Aql). God created the Intellect as the first and most beloved of all creation, tested its obedience through commands to advance and retreat, and declared that divine command, prohibition, punishment, and reward are all grounded in the Intellect. In the Shia intellectual tradition, this hadith establishes the Intellect ('Aql) as the cosmic basis of moral and religious accountability — meaning that humans are only held to divine law to the extent that they possess intellect.

en.hubeali: Abu Ja’far Muhammad Bin Yaqoub informed us saying, ‘It was narrated to us by a number of our companions, from them was Muhammad Bin Yahya Al Attar, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘When Allahazwj Created the ‘الْعَقْلَ’ (Aql - intellect)[1], Heazwj Interrogated it, then Said to it: “Come!” So it came. Then Said to it: “Turn back!” So it turned back.

Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Said: “By My<sup>azwj</sup> Might and My<sup>azwj</sup> Majesy! I<sup>azwj</sup> did not Create any creature which is more Beloved to Me<sup>azwj</sup> than you, nor will I<sup>azwj</sup> Perfect you except among the ones whom I<sup>azwj</sup> Love.
But, it is (based on) you that I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Command, and for you I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Forbid, and for you I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Punish, and for you I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Reward”’.
